role: Codex Korean academic editorial review; not Kiro CLI
scope: Conservative local style edits after substantive revisions

selfcheck.name: Proper names numbers dates citations and content anchors
selfcheck.detail: No named entity or technical formula edit. Literal protected elements matched; retained core measurement, outcome, covariate, uncertainty and negation content in each edited span.

selfcheck.name: Change-rate threshold
selfcheck.detail: No self-reported percentage is used as the authoritative result.

selfcheck.name: Genre
selfcheck.detail: Academic prose and its scientific terminology remain. No anecdote, new metaphor or blog-style passage.

selfcheck.name: Register and modality
selfcheck.detail: Preserved formal declarative register, uncertainty and obligation. Rolled back a candidate that would have changed important into should consider.

selfcheck.name: Residual stylistic patterns
selfcheck.detail: Reduced 따라서 from 10 to 2. Necessary statistical negations and academic clause punctuation remain. Did not diagnose C-11 as a document-wide removal target or claim all S1 patterns absent. Finalizer/code audit remains with parent.

selfcheck.name: No injected rhetoric
selfcheck.detail: No new facts, numerical illustrations, experiences, metaphors or artificial contrasts were inserted.

claim: No guarantee about authorship classification or AI detection.
